subject: Next steps: procurement route & marketplace preference — Hydra Health
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Rachael Ng <rachael.ng@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement route & marketplace preference — Hydra Health

Hi Rachael — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery + a couple asks so we can map you to the right commercial path.

Call recap (2 mins):
- Use case: patient-facing summarization + provider triage assistant; ~25k monthly active users, bursty nightly processing.
- Data residency: US-only.
- Security needs: SOC2 type II, SSO (SAML), optional customer-managed KMS.
- Forecast ask: starting pilot ~$6k/month, expected grow to $40–50k/month in 3–6 months.

Questions to confirm procurement readiness:
1) Preferred payment method for initial pilot: Purchase Order (PO) via finance or charge card?
2) Would you prefer to buy via AWS Marketplace (SaaS or Private Offer), or directly with a PO/contract with Redwood?
3) Do you need a standard vendor packet (W9, COI) or a longer security evidence packet (we can attach SOC2 report)?

I've attached a preliminary pricing estimate so you have numbers to share with finance.

Attachments: hydra_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page estimate)

Suggested next steps:
- Reply with PO vs card preference and whether Marketplace is preferred.
- If PO, please share any standard terms or a procurement contact; we can prepare a simple MSA + SOW or sign via Marketplace Private Offer.
- If you'd like, schedule a 30-min procurement sync next week — I can have Dev & Monica join to cover technical & onboarding items.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a one-page procurement checklist once you confirm the route.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-8123
From: Procurement Team <procurement@hydrahealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachael Ng <rachael.ng@hydrahealth.com>, IT Security <itsec@hydrahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement route & marketplace preference — Hydra Health

Maya — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side: 

- For the pilot, our finance team prefers a PO for any vendor > $5k/month, so PO is likely. We typically do net 30 on first time vendors.
- Marketplace: we prefer buying through AWS Marketplace where possible because it simplifies procurement and allows us to track spend per business unit. If Redwood supports Private Offers (or a SaaS contract via Marketplace) that would be ideal.
- We attached our standard procurement questionnaire — please fill and return. Also include W9 & SOC2 report if available.

Security question from IT: is customer-managed KMS supported for model keys (or are keys managed by Redwood)? Also need clarity on data retention — what logs/inputs are stored and retention windows.

I've attached: Hydra_Procurement_Questionnaire.xlsx (our standard)

Could we do a 30-min procurement + IT sync early next week (Tues/Wed morning PST)? Rachael and I will bring finance and ITSEC.

— Procurement Team (on behalf of Rachael)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: procurement route & marketplace preference — Hydra Health

Maya / Monica — forwarding Hydra's notes. Quick internal plan:

- Dev: I can prepare a short technical addendum on KMS and data retention (what we persist: aggregated metrics + KV cache eviction after 30 days by default; we can offer configurable retention & customer KMS for model artifacts on Dedicated/Private).
- Monica: can you pull SOC2 report & W9 from legal/finance and drop in our drive? I'll draft a Marketplace Private Offer note and a PO/Net30 billing flow.
- We should propose Monday/Tuesday 10–11am PST for procurement + IT sync (offer two slots).

Also recommend we offer a 3-month pilot with a capped spend (to reduce procurement friction) and a Marketplace Private Offer option with a 5% onboarding credit applied if they go via Marketplace.

Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@hydrahealth.com>
Cc: Rachael Ng <rachael.ng@hydrahealth.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement route & marketplace preference — Hydra Health

Rachael — appreciate the quick replies and the questionnaire. Short answers below and attached: our filled procurement questionnaire + pricing estimate.

1) Payment method: PO (Net 30) is fine for the pilot. We will accept a standard PO and issue invoices per the pilot schedule.
2) Marketplace: Redwood supports AWS Marketplace Private Offers. We are also in the process of listing a SaaS SKU; the Private Offer path is faster and will let finance consume via Marketplace with the same net-30 terms. We can create a Private Offer for Hydra that matches the attached pricing. Link to our Marketplace listing (private listing details will be provided in the PO): https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prod-Redwood-Inference
3) Security & docs: attached SOC2 Type II (redacted) and our completed questionnaire. On KMS: we support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated & Private deployments; for hosted (Redwood-managed) we offer encrypted-at-rest with Redwood KMS but can sign a tech addendum to describe key handling. Data retention: default logs/inputs retained 30 days; model cache ephemeral. We can extend retention windows on request (will note in SOW).

Attachments: procurement_questionnaire_filled.xlsx; hydra_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf; SOC2_Redwood_Redacted.pdf

Proposed times for the procurement+IT sync: Tue Apr 20, 10:00–10:30am PST or Wed Apr 21, 09:00–09:30am PST — let me know which works and we’ll send a calendar invite.

If PO is the route, please share the billing contact and exact purchase order language (our legal team is fine with standard SLAs and the pilot SOW).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
